# Documentation Conventions

## Rules
- Layout: `docs/{adr,cli,code-graph,core,guide,mcp,schemas,sdk,skills}/`. Outside `docs/`: only root `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`
- `docs/guide/`: user concepts, workflows, tutorials. Internal package/template/subsystem details belong in package refs (`docs/skills/`, `docs/core/`, `docs/code-graph/`)
- Every guide: Docusaurus frontmatter `title`, `description`, integer `sidebar_position`; compatible with `apps/public-web` generation and `@specd/guide` bundling
- Guide configuration/workflow/schema/lifecycle content MUST match `@specd/core`:
  - `FsArchiveRepository`: `{{year}}`, `{{month}}`, `{{day}}`, `{{date}}`, `{{change.name}}`, `{{change.archivedName}}`; never cite uninstalled engines
  - Document substitution for hooks (`run:`, `instruction:`) and schema artifacts (`template`, `instruction`, `deltaInstruction`, rules). `run:` inserted verbatim; SpecD translates only quote syntax unsupported by host shell. Non-Windows hooks use absolute `SHELL` when absolute, else `/bin/sh`. Never call this shell escaping
  - Exhaustive workspace config: `metadataPath`, `graph` discovery, `prefix` segment rules, reserved `root`
  - `specd project update`: orchestrates declared agent plugins; synthesizes `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, skill templates. Required after manual `plugins.agents` edits or SpecD upgrades; ordinary config resolves dynamically
  - Code Graph core capability across `code-graph.md`, `index.md`, `philosophy.md`, `skills.md`, `cli.md`: `--documents`, `--files`, `--spec <id>`, `--export <name> --from <surface>`, aggregated multi-file blast radius, direction/depth traversal, hotspots, implementation coverage
- Public docs start at `docs/guide/what-is-specd.md`: first sidebar page; explains SpecD and outcomes; presents symbol/document search, blast radius, spec-to-code traceability; links installation, quickstart, philosophy, guide index, `docs/guide/code-graph.md`. Index remains topic map and links opening page
- `docs/guide/skills.md`: skills as user↔CLI interface; slash command → agent steps → CLI; catalog `/specd`, `/specd-new`, `/specd-design`, `/specd-implement`, `/specd-verify`, `/specd-archive`, `/specd-compliance`, `/specd-fasttrack` plus usage guidance; `--format toon`, `specd guide`; files in `.agents/skills/`
- ADRs: MADR verbatim plus `### Spec` inside `## More Information`, linking specs capturing derived constraints. Frontmatter: `status`, `date`, `decision-makers`, `consulted`, `informed`. Required: `## Context and Problem Statement`; `## Decision Outcome` with `### Confirmation`; `## More Information` with `### Spec`. Other MADR sections optional when valueless
- ADR numbering: sequential from `0001`; filename `NNNN-kebab-title.md`; never reuse; deprecated/superseded retain number and update status
- Create ADR for decisions affecting multiple packages, constraining future development, or choosing non-obvious alternatives. Natural consequences of existing ADRs need none
- CLI: `docs/cli/index.md` command directory plus dedicated doc per `specd` command, including `guide.md` and lifecycle groups; purpose, flags, examples, exit codes. Document command-specific output, caching, machine contracts without implementation reading. Output-contract change updates matching reference same change. Tutorials/recipes remain `docs/guide/cli.md`
- MCP: each `@specd/mcp` tool/resource documented under `docs/mcp/` with input schema, output schema, example
- `docs/core/`: `@specd/core` package semantics/contracts/behavior, not host integration. Hosts (cli, mcp, API, IPC) import only `@specd/sdk`; never mix `@specd/core` and `@specd/code-graph`
- `docs/core/index.md` and `docs/code-graph/index.md`: prominent hosts-start-at-`docs/sdk/`, import-`@specd/sdk` callout
- `@specd/core` examples labeled plugin/core-only. Optional re-export note must not imply host choice. Core-only `plugin-*`, `skills` may primarily import `@specd/core`
- `docs/sdk/`: only Docusaurus integrator entry, category **SDK** before package refs. Examples import `@specd/sdk`; document single host surface on `"."`, `"./ports"`, `"./extensions"`; no parallel core/code-graph dependencies; `openSpecdHost`, `createSdkContext`, orchestration helpers; both `createKernel` + `kernel.*.execute()` and standalone `createX` / `create*Repository`
- Move legacy `docs/core/sdk.md` into `docs/sdk/`. Core/code-graph stay package refs for plugins/symbol semantics. Website API generation and landing copy treat `@specd/sdk` as integrator surface per `public-web:api-reference`
- JSDoc on every function, method, class, type alias, interface: description; `@param` each parameter; `@returns` except `void`/constructors; `@throws` each error type
- Public `@specd/core` composition changes update docs: canonical `createX(deps)`; convenience `createX(config, options?)`; roles of standalone factories, `createKernel(...)`, `createKernelBuilder()`; shared config-bootstrap `CompositionResolver`
- Same change updates every doc containing removed/renamed public template tokens, changed config cascade, or changed list/summary inputs, outputs, dependency-resolution contract
- `docs/guide/configuration.md` and `docs/guide/configuration-examples.md`: consistent cascade `specd.yaml` + `specd.*.yaml` + `specd.local.yaml`
- Search beyond illustrative scope: `docs/guide/{configuration,configuration-examples,installation,getting-started,workspaces,workflow,schemas}.md`, `docs/schemas/schema-format.md`, `docs/adr/0013-workspaces-not-scopes.md`, `docs/core/use-cases.md`, `docs/cli/cli-reference.md`

## Constraints
- Documentation Markdown only
- ADR filenames `NNNN-kebab-case-title.md`; sequential, never reused
- Every significant architectural decision has ADR
- Every ADR has `### Spec` inside `## More Information`; associated specs have `## ADRs`, omitted when none
- Spec `## ADRs` lists only provenance-producing ADRs, never dependencies
- Spec dependencies only through `## Spec Dependencies`; ADR constraints first captured in spec, then depended upon
- No docs outside `docs/` except `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`
- Template-token rename/removal or listing/summary contract change affects all applicable `docs/config/`, `docs/guide/`, `docs/schemas/`, `docs/adr/`, `docs/core/`, `docs/cli/` files
